profile.headline: Software Engineer at CRAY, Inc.
profile.summary:
Professional Experience (most recent first):

     15+ Years Operating System / Trusted Operating System Development
     7    Years Network Router Embedded Software / OS Development
     2    Years standards verification test suite development
     1    Year phototypesetter control embedded application development

Professional Goals:

     Continue to work in areas of software development that offer intellectual
     challenge and learning opportunities.

Specialties: Operating Systems and System Software development
Embedded Application Development
Network Infrastructure Software Development
Trusted Operating System Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: OS Kernel and Big Data Appliance software infrastructure developer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed IPv6 support using the the Broadcom XGS-3 network processor chip.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Developed infrastructure libraries for distributed routing software base. Provided operating system modifications to support Caspian's flow state based routing platform.  Served 2 years as System Architect defining and assisting development of component based architecture and management software.

positions.title: Member of Techincal Staff
positions.description: Provided design direction on Ascend's next generation core routing platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led development of the Trusted UNICOS, Trusted UNICOS-MK, and Trusted Irix projects.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Developer System V Verification Suite (SVVS) 1985-1986.  Kernel developer with emphasis on Multilevel Security and Trusted Systems 1986-1991.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Bare metal embedded application development. Designed and implemented machine control software for an automated microscope / differential tissue analyzer.
